title: Rhythm: Eighth Notes
description: Introduces the eighth note - two to a beat - by alternating C and D under the thumb and second finger, first alone and then against steady left-hand quarters.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Right hand alternates C4 and D4 (fingers 1-2) in eighths mixed with quarters and a half; from bar 5 the left hand keeps quarter notes on C3 as a metronome.
teachingPoints: Count '1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and'; each eighth note falls on a number or on an 'and'.
Bar 2: eight even eighths C-D-C-D - keep them level in volume and exactly two per count.
Bars 3-4 mix eighths and quarters: the quarter note is the moment you STOP moving for a whole count.
Bars 5-7: the left hand plays steady quarters on C; the right hand must fit exactly two eighths into each left-hand note.
